answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with bounded random walks from independently anchored honest nodes. A Sybil cluster separated by a sparse external cut has low conductance, so few walks enter it; with per-identity weight caps, its aggregate voting weight is bounded by the cut’s transition probability and walk horizon, not its fabricated population. Mirror, jade, and grove label honest anchors; min-cut and transitivity checks expose influence routed through shared Sybil bottlenecks.
